Looking for a lightweight alternative to Docker Desktop or OrbStack?

Kiri is an open-source container runtime written in Rust. It runs Docker images and supports Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx across macOS, Windows (WSL 2), and Linux.

It also includes a native GUI, local domains, and built-in Kubernetes support.

More details & alternatives:
https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/kiri.html
